payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Delisa, Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene, Tonya

payload.content: Raylene here. Planning update: I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0002::review (medium priority, cost 1.90) because it fits backend skill best and is efficient. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks due to very high cost. Please coordinate to avoid duplicate claims; if someone else targets ISSUE-0002::review, let me know and I can switch to skip or another feasible option.

Delisa planning update: I have strong api-development fit and 9h availability. My best feasible options are ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (all cost 1.94); ISSUE-0001::implement is more expensive (3.87), and ISSUE-0002 tasks are prohibitively costly for me. I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::review unless another agent already has it. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0002. Please share your intended picks so we can prevent duplicates.

Please let me know if anyone else is taking docs/triage so I can adjust to skip or another ISSUE-0001 micro-task.
